reply.text: Bigger friends at twelve usually just means they started growing earlier, and everyone gets there on their own schedule, so being behind them right now says nothing about how strong you'll end up. What builds strength at your age is learning good technique with light weight or bodyweight, such as push-ups, squats, pull-ups and planks, and showing up consistently two or three days a week. Eat enough real food, sleep a lot, and keep it fun. Chasing heavy weights early doesn't help, so ask a parent or a coach at your school or gym to watch your form. If you'd like a simple bodyweight routine to follow, tell me and I'll build it for you.
